Wait — should I consider the WETH utilization 86.73%? For a supplier, high utilization means withdrawals might be constrained, but idle liquidity of 323k WETH is plenty for a $1,000 position. Utilization at 86.73% is high-ish but Aave has reserve factors and this isn't a risk to the supplier's funds per se. Borrow APR 2.6% is low. Not a risk trigger.

rsETH details are irrelevant to a WETH supply position (user supplies WETH, not rsETH). Oracle for rsETH is fine anyway.

So: risk low, action hold. Reasons: position is WETH supply with no debt; onchain metrics normal with ample idle liquidity; the governance post is an unprompted instruction/prompt-injection with no corroborating evidence and should not be treated as a risk signal.
